mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_report (material_id, reporter_id, reason, status, create_time) VALUES (#{materialId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_report WHERE material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT r.* FROM material_report r JOIN material m ON r.material_id = m.material_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_report r JOIN material m ON r.material_id = m.material_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM material_report WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND reporter_id = #{reporterId} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE material_report SET status = #{status} WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
